summary.zh: 单个请求最多可用的 token 数，包括提示词和生成内容。
summary.en: The most tokens one request may use, prompt and output together.

what.zh: 模型在一次请求里能看到的最大 token 数。更长的请求会被拒绝。
what.en: The largest number of tokens the model sees in one request. Longer requests are rejected.

whenToChange.zh: 处理长文档、长对话或整个代码库时调大；只做短问答时调小以节省显存。
whenToChange.en: Raise it for long documents, long chats or whole code bases; lower it for short questions to save memory.

tradeoffs.zh: 越大越占 KV 缓存显存，同样的显存能同时服务的长请求越少。
tradeoffs.en: Larger values need more KV-cache memory, so fewer long requests fit at the same time.

summary.zh: 引擎同时处理的请求数上限，多出来的请求排队等待。
summary.en: How many requests the engine serves at the same time; the rest wait in a queue.

what.zh: 同时运行的请求（序列）数量上限。
what.en: The cap on requests (sequences) running at once.

whenToChange.zh: 多人或多个客户端同时使用时调大；单人使用长上下文时调小。
whenToChange.en: Raise it when several people or clients share the model; lower it for one user with long context.

tradeoffs.zh: 并发越高总吞吐越大，但每个请求分到的 KV 缓存越少，长请求更容易排队。
tradeoffs.en: More concurrency raises total throughput, but each request gets less KV cache and long requests queue sooner.

summary.zh: 客户端在 API 请求里用来指定这个模型的名字。
summary.en: The name clients use to pick this model in API requests.

what.zh: OpenAI 兼容接口 /v1/models 返回的模型名。留空时按模型目录或仓库名自动生成。
what.en: The model name listed by the OpenAI-compatible /v1/models endpoint. Empty means it is derived from the model folder or repository.

whenToChange.zh: 客户端配置里写死了某个模型名，或想给同一模型的不同启动方案起不同名字时。
whenToChange.en: When a client is configured with a fixed model name, or to tell launch variants of one model apart.

tradeoffs.zh: 改名后，仍按旧名字调用的客户端需要同步修改。
tradeoffs.en: Clients that still call the old name must be updated.

summary.zh: 权重与激活使用的浮点精度；auto 按模型配置选择。
summary.en: The floating-point type for weights and activations; auto follows the model config.

what.zh: 模型计算使用的数据类型。auto 读取模型 config.json 中的 torch_dtype。
what.en: The data type used for model computation. auto reads torch_dtype from the model's config.json.

whenToChange.zh: 较老的显卡不支持 BF16 时改为 float16；排查数值问题时可以试 float32。
whenToChange.en: Use float16 on older GPUs without BF16 support; try float32 when chasing numerical problems.

tradeoffs.zh: float32 精度最高，但显存和速度代价都很大；float16 在部分模型上可能溢出。
tradeoffs.en: float32 is the most precise but costs a lot of memory and speed; float16 can overflow on some models.

summary.zh: 权重使用的量化格式；留空时从模型配置自动识别。
summary.en: The quantization format of the weights; empty detects it from the model config.

what.zh: 量化权重的解码方式，例如 AWQ、GPTQ、FP8 或 NVFP4。模型 config.json 声明了 quant_method 时以模型为准。
what.en: How quantized weights are decoded, for example AWQ, GPTQ, FP8 or NVFP4. When the model's config.json declares quant_method, the model wins.

whenToChange.zh: 模型没有声明量化方式，或要把未量化的权重在线量化成 FP8 时。
whenToChange.en: When the model does not declare its quantization, or to quantize unquantized weights to FP8 while loading.

tradeoffs.zh: 格式选错会加载失败；在线量化省显存，但可能略微降低质量。
tradeoffs.en: A wrong format fails to load; quantizing while loading saves memory but can cost a little quality.

summary.zh: 单独指定分词器所在的目录或 Hugging Face 仓库。
summary.en: A separate folder or Hugging Face repository for the tokenizer.

what.zh: 默认使用模型目录里的分词器。GGUF 模型常常需要指向对应的原始仓库。
what.en: By default the tokenizer inside the model folder is used. GGUF models often need the original repository here.

whenToChange.zh: 模型目录缺少分词器文件，或 GGUF 转换出的分词器不准确时。
whenToChange.en: When the model folder has no tokenizer files, or the tokenizer converted from GGUF is inaccurate.

tradeoffs.zh: 分词器与模型不匹配会导致输出乱码。
tradeoffs.en: A tokenizer that does not match the model produces garbled output.

summary.zh: 允许加载模型仓库自带的 Python 代码。
summary.en: Allows the Python code shipped with the model repository to run.

what.zh: 新架构或自定义架构的模型需要执行仓库里的建模代码才能加载。
what.en: New or custom architectures need the repository's modeling code to load.

whenToChange.zh: 模型说明要求 trust_remote_code，或加载时报告未知架构时。
whenToChange.en: When the model card asks for trust_remote_code, or loading reports an unknown architecture.

tradeoffs.zh: 会在容器里执行第三方代码，只对来源可信的模型开启。
tradeoffs.en: Third-party code runs inside the container; turn it on only for models from sources you trust.

summary.zh: KV 缓存的数据类型；FP8 大约能省一半 KV 显存。
summary.en: The data type of the KV cache; FP8 roughly halves KV memory.

what.zh: 保存注意力键值（KV）使用的精度。auto 与模型计算精度相同。
what.en: The precision used to store attention keys and values. auto matches the model's compute dtype.

whenToChange.zh: 需要更长上下文或更多并发、而显存不够时选 FP8。
whenToChange.en: Choose FP8 when you need longer context or more concurrency than memory allows.

tradeoffs.zh: FP8 KV 可能轻微影响长上下文质量，部分模型路径不支持。
tradeoffs.en: FP8 KV can slightly reduce long-context quality, and some model paths do not support it.

summary.zh: 复用开头相同的提示词的计算结果，加快多轮对话和重复的系统提示。
summary.en: Reuses work for prompts that start the same way, which speeds up multi-turn chats and repeated system prompts.

what.zh: 默认（不设置）沿用引擎自己的行为；选择开或关会明确传给引擎。
what.en: Default (unset) keeps the engine's own behaviour; On or Off is passed to the engine explicitly.

whenToChange.zh: 排查与缓存相关的输出异常，或模型路径不支持前缀缓存时关闭。
whenToChange.en: Turn it off to rule out cache-related output problems, or when the model path does not support it.

tradeoffs.zh: 开启几乎总是更快，会用一部分 KV 缓存保存可复用的前缀。
tradeoffs.en: On is almost always faster; it keeps part of the KV cache for reusable prefixes.

summary.zh: 把每一层切开，放到几张 GPU 上一起计算。
summary.en: How many GPUs split each layer between them.

what.zh: 张量并行在层内切分权重，需要 GPU 之间有高速互联。
what.en: Tensor parallelism splits the weights inside each layer and needs fast links between the GPUs.

whenToChange.zh: 单卡放不下模型，或想用多卡加快单个请求时。
whenToChange.en: When the model does not fit on one GPU, or to speed up single requests with several GPUs.

tradeoffs.zh: 卡数必须能整除注意力头数；卡间带宽不足时提速有限。
tradeoffs.en: The GPU count must divide the attention heads; slow links limit the speed-up.

summary.zh: 把模型的层按顺序分成几段，放到不同的 GPU 上。
summary.en: Splits the model's layers into consecutive stages on different GPUs.

what.zh: 流水线并行按层分段，GPU 之间的通信量比张量并行少。
what.en: Pipeline parallelism splits by layer and needs less GPU-to-GPU traffic than tensor parallelism.

whenToChange.zh: 单卡放不下模型、而 GPU 之间只有 PCIe 等较慢的连接时。
whenToChange.en: When the model does not fit on one GPU and the GPUs only have slower links such as PCIe.

tradeoffs.zh: 单个请求的延迟通常高于张量并行，需要一定并发才能让各段都忙起来。
tradeoffs.en: Single requests are usually slower than with tensor parallelism; it needs concurrency to keep every stage busy.

summary.zh: 在多张 GPU 上各放一份完整模型，分摊请求。
summary.en: Runs a full copy of the model per GPU group and spreads requests across the copies.

what.zh: 每个副本独立处理请求，总吞吐随副本数增加。
what.en: Each replica serves requests on its own, so total throughput grows with the replica count.

whenToChange.zh: 单卡放得下模型、需要更高总吞吐时。
whenToChange.en: When one GPU holds the model and you need more total throughput.

tradeoffs.zh: 每个副本都需要完整的权重显存，单个请求不会变快。
tradeoffs.en: Every replica needs the full weight memory, and single requests do not get faster.

summary.zh: 把混合专家（MoE）模型的专家分到多张 GPU 上。
summary.en: Spreads the experts of a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model across GPUs.

what.zh: 只对 MoE 模型有效：不同专家放在不同的 GPU 上。
what.en: Only affects MoE models: different experts live on different GPUs.

whenToChange.zh: 多卡运行大型 MoE 模型、张量并行扩展效果不好时。
whenToChange.en: For large MoE models on several GPUs when tensor parallelism scales poorly.

tradeoffs.zh: 专家负载不均时，部分 GPU 会成为瓶颈。
tradeoffs.en: Uneven expert load can make some GPUs the bottleneck.

summary.zh: 把模型的思考过程从回答里拆出来，放进 reasoning_content 字段。
summary.en: Separates the model's thinking from the answer and returns it as reasoning_content.

what.zh: 不同模型标记思考内容的方式不同，解析器要与模型匹配。自动建议会按模型选择；关闭则原样输出。
what.en: Models mark their thinking differently, so the parser must match the model. Auto suggests one for the model; Off returns the raw text.

whenToChange.zh: 客户端看到 <think> 标签混在回答里，或思考内容丢失时。
whenToChange.en: When clients see <think> tags mixed into the answer, or the thinking goes missing.

tradeoffs.zh: 选错解析器可能吞掉部分回答。
tradeoffs.en: A wrong parser can swallow part of the answer.

summary.zh: 把模型输出的工具调用转换成 OpenAI 的 tool_calls 格式。
summary.en: Turns the model's tool calls into OpenAI tool_calls.

what.zh: 解析器要与模型的聊天模板匹配。自动建议会按模型推断；关闭则不解析工具调用。
what.en: The parser must match the model's chat template. Auto infers one from the model; Off leaves tool calls unparsed.

whenToChange.zh: Claude Code、OpenWebUI 等客户端调用工具失败，或工具调用以普通文本出现时。
whenToChange.en: When clients such as Claude Code or OpenWebUI fail to call tools, or tool calls show up as plain text.

tradeoffs.zh: 选错解析器会让工具调用失败或混进回答。
tradeoffs.en: A wrong parser makes tool calls fail or leak into the answer.

summary.zh: 允许模型自己决定是否调用工具（tool_choice=auto）。
summary.en: Lets the model decide by itself whether to call a tool (tool_choice=auto).

what.zh: 需要同时设置工具调用解析器才会生效。
what.en: Takes effect only together with a tool-call parser.

whenToChange.zh: 客户端只发送 tool_choice=required，或根本不用工具时可以关闭。
whenToChange.en: Turn it off when clients only send tool_choice=required, or use no tools at all.

tradeoffs.zh: 关闭后，没有明确要求工具的请求不会触发工具调用。
tradeoffs.en: When off, requests that do not explicitly require a tool never call one.

summary.zh: 客户端没有说明时，模型是否默认先思考再回答。
summary.en: Whether the model thinks before answering when the client does not say.

what.zh: 通过聊天模板参数 enable_thinking 设定默认值；客户端请求里的设置仍然优先。
what.en: Sets the chat template's default enable_thinking; a setting in the client's request still wins.

whenToChange.zh: 希望默认快速直接回答时选关；希望默认深入思考时选开。
whenToChange.en: Choose Off for quick direct answers by default, or On for deeper reasoning by default.

tradeoffs.zh: 思考会显著增加输出 token 数和等待时间。
tradeoffs.en: Thinking adds many output tokens and waiting time.

summary.zh: 先用草稿预测几个 token，再一次性验证，以加快生成。
summary.en: Drafts several tokens and verifies them in one step to speed up generation.

what.zh: 可用方式取决于引擎和模型：MTP 需要模型自带多 token 预测层，草稿模型方式需要额外的小模型。
what.en: The methods available depend on the engine and model: MTP needs the model's own multi-token prediction layers, draft-model methods need an extra small model.

whenToChange.zh: 单个请求生成太慢、显存还有余量时开启；排查问题时关闭。
whenToChange.en: Turn it on when single requests generate too slowly and memory allows; turn it off when troubleshooting.

tradeoffs.zh: 额外占用显存；并发越高加速越小，草稿接受率低时甚至会变慢。
tradeoffs.en: Uses extra memory; the gain shrinks at high concurrency and can become a slowdown when few drafts are accepted.

summary.zh: 每一步先猜几个 token 再验证。
summary.en: How many tokens are guessed before each verification step.

what.zh: 草稿越长，猜中时加速越明显。
what.en: Longer drafts help more when the guesses are accepted.

whenToChange.zh: 输出可预测（例如代码）、接受率高时调大；接受率低时调小。
whenToChange.en: Raise it when output is predictable (code, for example) and acceptance is high; lower it when acceptance is low.

tradeoffs.zh: 猜错的 token 会浪费计算，设得过大反而变慢。
tradeoffs.en: Rejected tokens waste compute, so too many slows generation down.

summary.zh: 推测解码使用的小模型路径。
summary.en: The path of the small model used for speculative decoding.

what.zh: 留空时在模型目录附近自动查找可用的草稿模型。
what.en: Empty means a suitable draft model is looked up next to the model.

whenToChange.zh: 自动查找不到草稿模型，或想换用另一个草稿模型时。
whenToChange.en: When no draft model is found automatically, or to use a different one.

tradeoffs.zh: 草稿模型必须与主模型使用同一分词器，并会额外占用显存。
tradeoffs.en: The draft must share the main model's tokenizer, and it uses extra memory.

summary.zh: 按主要使用的客户端调整推荐值，本身不改变启动参数。
summary.en: Tunes suggested values for your main client; it does not change launch flags by itself.

what.zh: 用于控制台的推荐值和网关默认行为，例如 Claude Code 桥接或 OpenWebUI。
what.en: Used for console suggestions and gateway defaults, for example the Claude Code bridge or OpenWebUI.

whenToChange.zh: 主要使用的客户端变了时。
whenToChange.en: When your main client changes.

tradeoffs.zh: 只影响推荐值，实际行为以各参数的设置为准。
tradeoffs.en: It only affects suggestions; the actual parameter values decide the behaviour.

summary.zh: 直接访问模型端口时需要提供的密钥；经网关访问不受影响。
summary.en: The key needed to call the model port directly; access through the gateway is unaffected.

what.zh: 设置后，绕过网关、直接访问引擎端口的请求必须带上这个密钥。密钥不会出现在启动命令或日志里。
what.en: When set, requests that reach the engine port directly, bypassing the gateway, must carry this key. It never appears in the launch command or the logs.

whenToChange.zh: 允许局域网设备直连模型端口时，强烈建议设置。
whenToChange.en: Strongly recommended when LAN devices can reach the model port directly.

tradeoffs.zh: 所有直连的客户端都要配置同一个密钥。
tradeoffs.en: Every direct client needs the same key.

summary.zh: 客户端没有指定时使用的采样温度。
summary.en: The sampling temperature used when the client does not set one.

what.zh: 温度越高输出越多样，越低越确定。
what.en: Higher temperature gives more varied output; lower gives more predictable output.

whenToChange.zh: 模型说明推荐了特定采样参数时。
whenToChange.en: When the model card recommends specific sampling values.

tradeoffs.zh: 这只是默认值，请求里的设置优先。
tradeoffs.en: This is only a default; the value in a request wins.

summary.zh: 客户端没有指定时使用的核采样阈值。
summary.en: The nucleus-sampling threshold used when the client does not set one.

what.zh: 只从累计概率达到这个值的候选 token 中采样。
what.en: Samples only from the most likely tokens whose probabilities add up to this value.

whenToChange.zh: 模型说明推荐了特定采样参数时。
whenToChange.en: When the model card recommends specific sampling values.

tradeoffs.zh: 越小输出越保守，越大越多样。
tradeoffs.en: Smaller values give more conservative output, larger values more varied output.

summary.zh: 客户端没有指定时，每一步只从概率最高的 k 个 token 中采样。
summary.en: When the client does not say, each step samples only from the k most likely tokens.

what.zh: 限制每一步候选 token 的数量。0 表示不限制。
what.en: Limits how many candidate tokens each step considers. 0 means no limit.

whenToChange.zh: 模型说明推荐了特定采样参数时。
whenToChange.en: When the model card recommends specific sampling values.

tradeoffs.zh: 越小输出越保守，越大越多样。
tradeoffs.en: Smaller values give more conservative output, larger values more varied output.

summary.zh: 传给聊天模板的默认参数（JSON 对象），例如 enable_thinking。
summary.en: Default arguments for the chat template, as a JSON object, such as enable_thinking.

what.zh: 客户端请求里的 chat_template_kwargs 会覆盖同名的项。
what.en: chat_template_kwargs in a client request override matching keys.

whenToChange.zh: 模型模板支持额外的开关、需要统一默认值时。
whenToChange.en: When the model's template has extra switches you want to default.

tradeoffs.zh: 键名必须与模板一致，写错会被静默忽略。
tradeoffs.en: Keys must match the template; unknown keys are silently ignored.

summary.zh: 指定权重文件的格式；auto 按目录里的文件判断。
summary.en: Which weight file format to load; auto decides from the files present.

what.zh: auto 在目录里只有 GGUF 文件时按 GGUF 加载，否则按 Hugging Face 格式加载。
what.en: auto loads GGUF when the folder only holds GGUF files, and the Hugging Face format otherwise.

whenToChange.zh: 目录里同时有多种格式、自动判断不对时。
whenToChange.en: When a folder holds several formats and auto picks the wrong one.

tradeoffs.zh: vLLM 对 GGUF 的支持仍是实验性的。
tradeoffs.en: vLLM's GGUF support is still experimental.

summary.zh: 默认采样参数的来源：模型自带、引擎内置或指定路径。
summary.en: Where default sampling values come from: the model, the engine's built-in defaults, or a path.

what.zh: auto 读取模型的 generation_config.json；vllm 使用引擎内置默认值；也可以填写目录路径。
what.en: auto reads the model's generation_config.json; vllm uses the engine's built-in defaults; a folder path also works.

whenToChange.zh: 模型自带的生成配置导致异常输出（例如不停重复某个字符）时改为 vllm。
whenToChange.en: Switch to vllm when the model's own generation config causes bad output, such as one character repeating.

tradeoffs.zh: 改为 vllm 后，模型作者推荐的采样值不再生效。
tradeoffs.en: With vllm, the sampling values the model author recommends no longer apply.
